data.name: Horror At The Secret Hotel (Part 1) (2014) (Fanfic Reading) (Cringe Warning)
data.description:
The CMC sneak out for a secret holiday, only to be catapulted into a maelstrom of chaos, as an old enemywatches from the shadows, having awaited them for so long...

I'll be straight up with this. The second half is cringe. I apologize in the video, but it bears repeating. It was an innocent idea that went well beyond what it should have been. In my opinion, you should just wait for the end of the scene just before the Ferris Wheel part, then skip to part 2. If you want to see this idea done better, just watch the original Vacational Death Cruise comic, (which, you can find on YouTube, or you can find the lost dub of it on my archive channel).

Written on - 17 July 2014
Art, by me - Completed on: 21 June 2026
